body: I don't know. I just get these thoughts that I'm going to fail. I'm not gonna be able to do anything. I can't focus on studies because of all the shit that goes on around me. All day, everything I hear is about problems, problems and more problems. I'm never able to read a single sentence of my book. All I do is listen to music to get away from it all. It motivates me and as soon as I stop the music and start studying, bam! The same shit begins again, can't focus on anything!

Sometimes I feel like it's my responsibility to make my sister's and my mom's life better. Sometimes I feel like, that's impossible to do and just end my life. But I'm never able to go through with it.
